rationale: PracticeSession completes after setting enemyLane equal to the current lane, leaving lane===enemyLane true on its terminal snapshot. The collector checked the DOM success button before reading that snapshot but did not check snapshot.complete, so it attempted another direction tap after success removed the old controls. Adding the missing terminal condition allows native390and320practice and full lifecycle to pass on a526; the practice/game model was not changed for this fix.

actual_next_action.description: Inspected the terminal practice snapshot and collector branch, added if(s.complete)break, then reran native mobile practice and full lifecycles successfully.
